description: Source code for thermistor sensor handling, including temperature calculations, resistance conversions, and configuration setup for engine sensors.

classes.name: ThermistorMath
classes.description: Class providing thermistor temperature calculations and configuration handling.

methods.name: getKelvinTemperatureByResistance
methods.description: Calculates temperature in Kelvin from resistance using Steinhart-Hart equation.

methods.name: getResistance
methods.description: Calculates resistance of thermistor based on voltage and configuration.

methods.name: getTemperatureC
methods.description: Gets temperature in Celsius from thermistor readings, optionally linear.

methods.name: prepareThermistorCurve
methods.description: Prepares Steinhart-Hart curve parameters based on resistance-temperature points.

methods.name: setConfig
methods.description: Sets thermistor configuration and recalculates curve.
